BigPicture is built from a set of services. Filter by what you want to do, or open any service for its details.

```{=html}
<div class="proto-filter" role="group" aria-label="Filter by purpose">

</div>
```

::: {.proto-intro purpose="exploration"}
You can look around BigPicture without an account. These services show what is in the archive, how much of it there is, and how it is described.
:::

::: {.proto-intro purpose="access"}
Getting data takes a login, permission for a dataset, and knowing what you are asking for. These services handle each part.
:::

::: {.proto-intro purpose="contributing"}
Sharing data means logging in, describing your slides in the agreed standard, and moving them securely into the archive. These services do that.
:::
